text:
maya: Quick design pass — thinking about a ‘quiet mode’ for the preflight probe step so the stepper isn’t flooded with micro-updates. Figma mock: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/preflight-quiet-mode (frame: probe-compact). Thoughts? :thinking_face:
kevin: I like reducing noise. main concern: discoverability of failures. if a probe fails we should still pop a visible CTA + toast. maybe keep compact rows but bold failures and add a 1-line summary at top.
anya: Agreed. Also accessibility: screen readers need an aria-live for the summary region so users hear overall status, not every probe line. suggest: `aria-live="polite"` on the status banner.
sam: Small copy nit — current row copy says "port check successful" which is verbose. prefer "Port open" / "Port closed" to keep scanning readable at a glance.
nora: For keyboard users, when you expand a probe detail it should trap focus inside panel and pressing Escape should collapse — currently focus jumps. This is a11y regression from last iteration.
maya: Good call, keeping failures visible + aria-live on summary. For quiet mode I tried two approaches: (1) collapse successful probes into a single summary line + chevron to expand, (2) show compact list with subtle dimming for success. which do you prefer?
kevin: option (1) scales better for large host lists. option (2) is nicer for single-host flows. maybe switch based on host count: compact list if <=3 hosts, collapsed summary if >3.
anya: conditional behavior is fine as long as we expose it in docs and we announce the collapse/expand change for assistive tech. include `role="region"` and a visually-hidden status update: "Showing 4 of 12 probes — 8 hidden" when collapsed.
sam: UX microcopy: top summary should read: "Network checks — 8/12 passing" (not 'successful'). shorter and consistent with other console panels.
maya: Nice. what about the inline retry affordance? current button label is "Retry probe" — too long. propose `Retry` with an icon and accessible label `aria-label="Retry network probe for host x"`.
nora: Confirming keyboard order: Retry should be after details toggle in DOM so tab order matches visual. Also add `aria-disabled` instead of removing button when probe is running.
kevin: Performance note — if we collapse successes we can avoid rendering full detail components for hidden probes which should lower memory and reflow during scans. engineering + design need to sync on placeholder heights to avoid layout jumps.
maya: I'll update Figma with collapse/expand behavior and add examples for 2, 5, 20 hosts. will also draft the concise copy strings:
```
Summary banner: "Network checks — 8 of 12 passing"
Collapsed row: "5 successful probes hidden — expand to view"
Row states: "Port open" / "Port closed" / "DNS resolved" / "DNS failed"
Action: "Retry" (icon)
```
kevin: Looks good. one more: when a probe is flaky we should show a subtle amber icon + tooltip: "Intermittent success — last 3 attempts: 2/3". not a hard error.
anya: Tooltip needs to be keyboard accessible (focusable trigger) and announced by screen readers when focused. use `role="button"` and add `aria-describedby` to point to the tooltip body.
sam: Can we shorten help links? instead of "Learn more about network probes" use just "Network probe docs".
maya: I'll push an a11y checklist and updated mocks by EOD and open a follow-up PR for copy strings. tagging @kevin @anya @nora for final sign-off.
deploy-bot: New figma file version uploaded by maya at 2026-03-23T10:12:11Z — comment thread created. :robot_face:
kevin: quick QA note — when collapsed, mobile layout needs the expand affordance to be full-width for easier tap targets.
anya: And ensure color contrast for the dimmed success text meets 4.5:1 — lower contrast may look subtle but fails WCAG.
maya: Good catches. thanks all — will iterate and post updated protos here. :pray:
